name: sonic-provider-admin-mohr
description: Resolved preset of impersonate-tenant: host admin -> impersonate Admin Mohr into DFR - Sonic Health Plus (Provider), lands on the Provider portal Team Dashboard

params.tenantMatch: Row with Trading name 'DFR - Sonic Health Plus', Tenancy name 'SonicHealthcare', Type 'Provider' (there is also a 'Sonic Health Plus - DFR*' Provider row with tenancy 'SonicHealthPlusDFR' -- that one is NOT this tenant, disambiguate by tenancy name SonicHealthcare)

steps.expect: Tenants list visible; runs login.json first if not authenticated

steps.target: Tenant name / tenancy code search input
steps.expect: filtered list shows 'Sonic Health Plus - DFR*' and 'DFR - Sonic Health Plus' rows

steps.target: Login button in the row with Tenancy name 'SonicHealthcare' (DFR - Sonic Health Plus, Provider type, ~73 users, ~5137 bookings)
Impersonate button in the row for 'Admin Mohr* (management@myocchealthrecord.com)'
steps.expect: redirect to {provider}/#/app/main/provider/team-dashboard (or similar), Team Dashboard visible with Onsite Booking Calendar + Waitlist

verifiedSessionCookies.note: After this flow, document.cookie should contain MOHR.TenantId.localhost and MOHR.AuthToken.localhost (a JWT). Decode the JWT payload to sanity-check tenant_name/user_email/is_provider claims match what was intended -- useful smoke check whenever cookie-handling code changes.

usefulNavigationFromHere.hits: assessment block list -- open any row's Start button to reach a block's Tests/Determination/Summary tabs (exercises master-assessment.service.ts / JsonHelper node-search, and assessment-test.component.ts for question-driven test types e.g. 'Maths Test', 'Psychology Interview')

usefulNavigationFromHere.note: Known local-dev-only noise seen in this area, NOT related to app code: 'Missing PDF file... 404' from mohr-local-dev S3 bucket (test fixture PDFs don't exist in local S3), 'Error parsing user customisation' JSON.parse warning, NG0100 on _AddNoteTabComponent when the Notes '+' icon is clicked. None of these reference JsonHelper/UrlHelper/CookieHelper/UtilsHelper.
